answer: Persistent Task Seed Ledger: each new identity must complete a unique, verifiable micro-task drawn from a shared grove of pre-committed work orders before it can hold or transfer value. Duplicate agents can't reuse completed seeds—each claim consumes one order and logs a signed receipt on an island of append-only shards. Because seeds are scarce and non-fungible, a clone must buy fresh unclaimed orders at market price plus spend compute to solve them. A crystal of verified history forms only after N distinct seeds, so the marginal clone's expected yield falls below its seed and compute cost,
